summary.text: Unforeseen Disaster is an immortal killer move named when Immortal Zombie Giant Sun takes Fang Yuan's place.

claims.text: Immortal Zombie Giant Sun stands up and takes Fang Yuan’s place after the totems. He has already prepared his killer move and uses it with no hesitation. He grabs at his head repeatedly with palms covered in a layer of light. The pure gold light around his palms is rapidly dyed black and red. Every time he grabs, he throws as well. Dark-red bad luck flies in the air, turning into lumps of dark-red clouds that fly everywhere. Each lump of dark-red cloud is not large. Wherever they go, soul beasts within a hundred li howl for a few breaths of time before losing their lives, giant arms break, and large segments of the soul river also break apart. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s body itself becomes unstable after being hit by this method. His left head shouts as it uses burning soul bursting luck. His luck immediately rises and offsets Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s method. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun attacks for a while before stopping. It is not that his immortal essence is not enough or his mind got tired. It is because he has used up all his bad luck.

Fang Yuan is slightly moved as he observes Immortal Zombie Giant Sun. If he could use all of his bad luck to attack, then his own luck would always remain at the highest level. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun has an excellent combat system. This method definitely has high importance in this combat system. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun’s unforeseen disaster killer move is similar to Dang Hun Luo Po Seal, but these soul beasts can still resist unforeseen disaster killer move for a while. Against Dang Hun Luo Po Seal, they have no ability to resist.

The intense golden light around Immortal Zombie Giant Sun dims rapidly. He has all kinds of killer moves that help him to maintain positive and powerful luck, for instance the unforeseen disaster killer move he used in the Door of Life and Death, to extract his bad luck to deal with the enemy. Although it reduced the size of his luck, his luck path methods quickly restored it. On the whole, his luck became even better.
